blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Operatives arrested on Sunday Caraga region’s fifth most wanted person, who is facing a murder charge, in Agusan del Sur. Police Col. Romeo Villalobos Jr., Agusan del Sur police provincial director, identified the suspect only by his alias, “Lando.” He is 44 and a farmer residing in Barangay Bunawan Brook, Bunawan town. Lando was cornered during a joint law enforcement operation in Barangay Poblacion, Rosario town, on Nov. 1.
